name: @lionad/safe-npx
description: Safe npx wrapper - lock to latest-1 version with 24h cache

scripts.bundle:all: bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile snpx-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile snpx-darwin-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile snpx-linux-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile snpx-windows-x64.exe

author: 仿生狮子 <tangnad@qq.com> (https://github.com/Lionad-Morotar)
